invite.subject: You have been invited to Foldex
invite.heading: You have been invited{{if .By}} by {{.By}}{{end}} to Foldex.
body: Open the link below to choose a password and activate your account.
invite.action: Choose a password and activate my account
invite.footnote: The link expires in {{.ExpiresHours}} hours and can be used once. If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this message.

password_reset.subject: Reset your Foldex password
password_reset.heading: Someone asked to reset the password for your Foldex account.
body: Open the link below to choose a new password.
password_reset.footnote: The link expires in {{.ExpiresMinutes}} minutes and can be used once. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this message — your password will not change.

reset_unavailable.subject: Reset your Foldex password
reset_unavailable.heading: Someone asked to reset the password for your Foldex account.
body: This account signs in with Google, so it has no password to reset.
Use “Continue with Google” on the sign-in screen.
reset_unavailable.footnote: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this message.

login_code.subject: Foldex sign-in code: {{.Code}}
login_code.heading: Your Foldex sign-in code
login_code.footnote: It expires in {{.ExpiresMinutes}} minutes and can be used once. If you are not signing in right now, someone may know your password — change it.

enroll_email_2fa.subject: Foldex two-factor code: {{.Code}}
enroll_email_2fa.heading: Confirm this address as your second factor.
enroll_email_2fa.footnote: It expires in {{.ExpiresMinutes}} minutes and can be used once. If you did not ask to add e-mail as a second factor, ignore this message — nothing changes until the code is entered.

step_up_code.subject: Foldex security code: {{.Code}}
step_up_code.heading: Confirm a change to your security settings.
step_up_code.footnote: It expires in {{.ExpiresMinutes}} minutes and can be used once. If you did not start this change, do not enter the code — someone may be signed in to your account. Change your password and sign out everywhere.

verify_email.subject: Confirm your Foldex e-mail
verify_email.heading: Confirm this address for your Foldex account.
body: Open the link below to finish confirming your e-mail address.
verify_email.footnote: The link expires in {{.ExpiresMinutes}} minutes and can be used once. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this message.

admin_recovery.subject: Account recovery was requested for your Foldex account
admin_recovery.heading: An administrator started account recovery for your Foldex account.
body: Open the link below to choose your own new password. Nobody else gets to see it.
admin_recovery.footnote: The link expires in {{.ExpiresMinutes}} minutes and can be used once. Your password and sessions do not change until you use it. If you did not expect this, tell your administrator and ignore this message.

session_revoked.subject: Your Foldex sessions were signed out
session_revoked.heading: Your Foldex sessions were signed out.
body: A session token for your Foldex account was replayed, which usually means it was copied from your device.
As a precaution every active session was signed out. Sign in again to continue.
session_revoked.footnote: If this was not you, change your password after signing in. This message carries no link on purpose — Foldex never asks you to click one to secure your account.

recovery_code_used.subject: A Foldex recovery code was used
recovery_code_used.heading: A recovery code was just used to sign in to your Foldex account.
recovery_code_used.footnote: If this was not you, change your password and regenerate your recovery codes now.

account_converted.subject: Your Foldex account now uses Google sign-in
account_converted.heading: Your Foldex account now signs in with Google ({{.GoogleEmail}}).
body: Its password has been removed, and every other session was signed out.
account_converted.footnote: If this was not you, contact your Foldex administrator immediately: whoever did this knew your password, and password reset no longer applies to this account.
